title: Every morning he hallowed himself anew in the presence of some holy image or mystery.
html_source:
His daily routines shows Stephen’s true devotion to religion that come about in this chapter especially. For a christian, it is important to make religion a part of everyday life and give yourself and your grace to the God, Jesus Christ, the Holy Spirit, and/or Mary.

Praying to holy images and figures or even attending church everyday is a way to accomplish this.
